character.name: Pixel art RPG enemy. A cute but gross living blob of snot. The color is a sickly pale bluish-grey, almost white, slightly translucent. It has a gooey, sticky texture with dripping strands of mucus hanging from it. Round, amorphous shape. It has large, innocent black bead eyes that contrast with its gross material. Shiny and wet appearance. Low top-down view. Dark outline.
